description:
A multi-platform proxy client based on Clash Meta,simple and easy to use, open-source and ad-free.


Features
- editor Editor word wrap and snippets
- dashboard More dashboard cards
- views Hide timed-out nodes and search every list
- ui Sidebar, floating dock and drag to go back
- ui New app glyphs, empty states and theme page
- overwrite Invalid override warnings and rule presets
- config DNS query log and per-key DNS/NTP overrides
- core Proxied service checks and outbound IP risk
- platform Tray hotkeys, node delays and a delay test
Bug Fixes
- core A changed resource link is now used by the next sync and by auto update
- core DNS lookups no longer fail on networks that report no DNS servers
- proxies Smaller icons in icon-only group headers
- core,android Push notifications reconnect in Doze
- backup,database Restores never apply halfway
